scope: Independent Blackwatch corpse contact/rest/cut review; two proven angular-coordinate defects repaired in both ports.
playerVisibleStatus: The reported fish-like corpse hopping is not reproduced or accepted as fixed by this code-only audit.
currentPriorFixesConfirmed: 13 anatomical rigid owners and a separate 16-fragment reserve remain in place.
Post-constraint retained-velocity rejection and support-propagated sleep remain in place.
CorpseFragmentMotion.drop remains an absolute elapsed-time parabola clamped to ground.

provenDefects.before: World-space lever arm cross world-space kick was added directly to Part.spin. Part.step integrates spin in the local frame with rotation.rotateXYZ. Once a corpse part has rotated, a later hit therefore rotates the intended torque a second time.
provenDefects.after: Convert the bounded world angular impulse by inverse part rotation before adding it to local spin.

provenDefects.before: Local Part.spin was crossed with a world-space cut-face offset, giving the wrong surface velocity after corpse rotation.
provenDefects.after: Use the existing fragmentVelocity local angular-cross-local offset calculation, then rotate the result once into world space.

unchanged: No gravity, restitution, friction, sleep thresholds, support graph, cut budget, grabbing eligibility, or saved world was modified.

standaloneJomlCheck.limit: Standalone coordinate math only; this does not execute Minecraft or the actual private Part/Body solver.

independentContactCheck.result: All ten connected bodies reached 24 quiet half-steps in every case; final 199 half-steps had zero root-height range and zero completed movement.
independentContactCheck.limit: A deliberately simplified two-dimensional flat-ground solver probe. It omits real Minecraft shape collision, arbitrary three-dimensional skin and live capture. It cannot rule out stair, edge or cut-specific player-visible failures.

validationBoundary: No Gradle, game launch, computer input or save access. Added JUnit cases await parent-owned execution. Actual player-view normal/heavy soldier deaths, cutting, repeated postmortem impacts and stairs/edges still require normal-client acceptance.

parentVerification.playerAcceptance: Still pending; this does not establish that fish-like hopping is resolved.
